prompt: A triangle has a base of $12$ and a height of $5$. What is its area?
hint: Area of a triangle is half the base times the height.

hints.text: Area of a triangle is half the base times the height.

learningObjective: Compute the area of a triangle.
explanation: Forgetting the $\tfrac{1}{2}$ gives $60$, which is the area of the surrounding rectangle — and an answer choice.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why the one-half is there
steps: Any triangle is exactly half of a rectangle with the same base and height.
Draw the rectangle around it and the halving becomes obvious rather than memorized.
This also explains why the height must be perpendicular to the base — it is the side of that rectangle.
